name: Stuck
source:
Burnt out and depressed, Ian moved back in with his parents years ago. Now that it is just him and his abusive mother, living in that house has only become more of a nightmare. Thankfully, Ian has his best friend, Percy, and his new friend, Marie.

[From [url=https://sierraphantom.itch.io/stuck]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
身心俱疲、深陷抑郁的伊恩在几年前搬回了父母家中。如今家里只剩下他和动辄虐待他的母亲，住在这栋屋子里更是变成了一场彻头彻尾的噩梦。所幸的是，伊恩身边还有挚友珀西，以及新结识的朋友玛丽。

[摘自[url=https://sierraphantom.itch.io/stuck]itch.io[/url]]
